statement:
The record shows **unpaid** status for invoice 88412 from Atlas Supply, despite a conflicting note about a prior payment.

I will **hold** this invoice to resolve the discrepancy before taking further action.
judge_text:
WRONG
It names the specific contradiction — "unpaid status ... despite a conflicting note about a prior payment" — and refuses to pay, holding the invoice to resolve the discrepancy.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
